mechanism: Isoniazid inhibits CYP2E1 and may increase acetaminophen metabolism to toxic N-acetyl-p-benzoquinone imine (NAPQI), increasing hepatotoxicity risk, particularly with chronic use or in patients with hepatic impairment.
action: Monitor liver function tests (AST/ALT) periodically; use acetaminophen at lowest effective dose and avoid chronic high-dose use; counsel patients to limit acetaminophen intake and avoid alcohol.
